US Officials Visit Myanmar to Secure Release of American Citizen

US officials undertook a rare visit to Myanmar with the objective of securing the release of an American businessman, identified by one outlet as a former marine. The visit occurred as the isolated Myanmar regime reportedly seeks greater international recognition. The specific details of the negotiations or the outcome of the visit were not provided in the coverage.
